name: n4_read_audit
description: Answer who changed what on the connected station, in one call: the records of its audit trail (history /<station>/AuditHistory, written by Config/Services/AuditHistoryService), newest first, each {timestamp, operation, target, slot, old_value, value, user}: timestamp is ISO-8601 with the station's offset; target is the component's slot path as the station stores it (/Folder/Point, no slot: scheme); slot is the property or action name (a/b for a nested property); old_value and value are the station's text of the values (empty for an action or an added slot). Narrow it with target (a component ORD such as station:|slot:/Folder/Point; matches it and everything below it) or target_glob (a BQL like pattern over the stored slot path such as /Folder/*/Point; no quote, space, '$' or '|'), at most one; slot (exact slotName, e.g. overAmpsDelay); user (exact userName); operation (Changed, Added, Removed, Renamed, Reordered, Flags Changed, Facets Changed or Invoked; logins and recategorizations go to the security audit history instead); and either period or start/end (BAbsTime, e.g. 2026-11-15T00:00:00.000-06:00, or a span back from now such as 30m, 24h or 7d). limit (default 100, 1 to 1000) caps the records returned. truncated is true when more records match than were returned; total_records is their count (select count(*) with the same filters), null with total_records_note when that count failed. The audit history keeps 500 records and rolls by default, so old changes may be gone. Every filter value is checked on its decoded form before any request. Read-only: fixed queries over the history: ORD.

target.description: Component ORD whose audit records to read, itself and below, e.g. station:|slot:/Folder/Point

target_glob.description: BQL like pattern over the stored target slot path, '*' any run of characters, e.g. /Folder/*/Point

slot.description: Exact slot (property or action) name, or a nested property path a/b, e.g. overAmpsDelay

user.description: Exact user name that made the change, e.g. admin

period.description: Named time range; or give start/end

start.description: Oldest record time as a BAbsTime, e.g. 2026-11-15T00:00:00.000-06:00, or a span back from now: 30m, 24h, 7d

end.description: Newest record time as a BAbsTime, e.g. 2026-11-15T23:59:59.999-06:00, or a span back from now: 30m, 24h, 7d

limit.description: Most recent matching records to return

timeout_s.description: HTTP timeout per request in seconds
